tasks.task: I accidentally reopened the task for Carol Lee and need it back in my active queue, but with an updated due date so it won’t be missed. Please find Carol Lee’s task (“Sample Title 3”), verify it’s currently active, update it to be due tomorrow (English parsing), and then confirm the due date was saved correctly.

success_criteria: The task fetched in step 2 has id equal to the Carol Lee task and status is "active".
After step 3, the task’s due field reflects a due date parsed from "tomorrow" with due_lang "en".
Step 4 returns the same task id and shows the updated due information persisted.

tasks.task: Before end of day, make sure Carol Lee’s task “Sample Title 3” (task id todoist__1003) is clearly flagged for the audit by setting it to highest priority and adding labels audit and urgent, then verify the updates took effect. Do not attempt to reopen it unless it is completed.

success_criteria: The final getTask returns id todoist__1003 for “Sample Title 3”.
The task remains not completed (i.e., status is active / not completed) and no reopen was attempted.
The task has priority set to 4.
The task’s labels include both “audit” and “urgent”.
